DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_Anubis:
Once seen as a symbol of nobility, 
and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power.
Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.

Leaves gnawed <itemName id=|Horn| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s and hunts for meat while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
